relationship_description: Married couple, Victor was Governor and Congressman of La Union, Mary Jane was Mayor of San Fernando City (1998-2007)
Brothers, both served as Governor and Representative of La Union at different times
Brothers, Pablo is Representative of La Union's first district
Brothers, Mario ran for Vice Governor of La Union
Brothers, Jose Maria (Pepe) ran for San Fernando City mayor
Brothers, Francisco Jr. (Kit) is provincial board member and ran for Luna mayor
Brothers, Ramon (Monetsky) is San Fernando City councilor
Brothers, Robert (Bungo) was councilor of Baguio City (deceased 2017)
Uncle-nephew, Joaquin was the first Filipino civil governor of La Union appointed in 1901, Victor's uncle
Father-son, Emmanuel Victor (Mannix) is provincial board member representing ABC
Father-daughter, Michelle ran for Caba town mayor after her father's death
Married couple who succeeded each other as mayors of Amulung, Cagayan (Nicanor 1996-2007, Pacita 2007-2010), both convicted of graft and malversation
Uncle-nephew, Fidel was Supreme Court Justice, Mark Anthony is son of Judge Amante Purisima
Father-son, Amante was retired Manila Judge, Mark Anthony is lawyer involved in 1999 Bar scandal
Brothers, Fidel was Supreme Court Justice, Amante was Manila Judge
Brothers-in-law, Leopoldo is Villar's brother-in-law serving as barangay councilor
